tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ bka' srung mched gsum gtor 'bul rgyun khyer bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ra be/
gtor ma zur gsum che chung gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/

hūm̐ bhyo: rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i zhing: thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje phag mo'i bka' srung che: ma mo mched gsum dam la 'dus: ma: dbyings kyi yum chen spyang zhon ma: rab khros gri gug thod khrag bsnams: ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: 'dir byon dgyes pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// bhyo: ye shes pho nya stag zhon ma: dmar mo gri gug sbrul zhags 'dzin: sha za 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas: 'di byon dgyes pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// dza: las kyi mngag gzhug 'phar zhon ma: sngon mo gri gug lcags kyu bsnams: las byed 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas: 'dir byon dgyes pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// ma ma traka raksha hūm̐ sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hiḥ bhyo rakmo bhyo sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hiḥ dzaḥsma sha ni phaṭa sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hiḥ

hūm̐ bhyoḥ bcom ldan he ru ka dpal dang: yum chen badzra bha ra hi: rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ltar: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad dang gnod pa thams cad sol// yul 'khor kun srungs dgra bgegs sgrol// mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// bcol pa'i las kun 'grub par mdzod//
ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i phyir du padma gar dbang rtsal gyis gter gzhung las khol du phyung ba dge legs 'phel/// /
